title: Sorted Signal Lookup
description: Given a sorted array of integers and a target value, return the zero-based index of the target. If the target is absent, return -1.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; values are sorted in non-decreasing order; -10^9 <= values[i], target <= 10^9.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n sorted integers. Third line: target.
outputFormat: Print the zero-based index of the target, or -1.
hints: Compare the target with the middle element and discard half of the remaining range.

examples.explanation: 7 does not occur in the sorted array.
